description: This file is a Perl script that functions as a wrapper for compiling or linking files using MSVC, specifically tailored for use with GNU Make to facilitate building Git on Windows with MSVC. It processes command-line arguments to set compilation flags, handle file outputs, and invoke the appropriate compiler or linker.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments to determine compilation or linking actions and invokes the compiler or linker with the constructed command.
